audio_description:
The vast ring of the Esthar Lunar Base turns against the stars.
Spacesuited figures float outside the station near a glowing green console.
One drifts free on a tether along the station's long spine.
The station begins to come apart.

context.scene_title: The Lunar Base — Squall and Rinoa in spacesuits at the Esthar space station (Disc 3).
locations: The Lunar Base, Esthar's ring-shaped orbital space station (marked 'ESTHAR'), and the open space around it

characters.name: (spacesuited figures — Squall and Rinoa)
characters.recognition: White-suited, helmeted astronauts drifting in space near the station and a green holographic panel; their faces are hidden by helmets but they are Squall and Rinoa (with another party member).

context.summary: The vast ring of the Esthar Lunar Base turns against the stars. Spacesuited figures float outside the station near a glowing green console; one drifts free on a tether along the station's long spine as the structure begins to come apart — the perilous spacewalk sequence at the Lunar Base.
context.context_note: High confidence: the Lunar Base space station and the spacewalk (the suited figures are Squall and Rinoa; faces hidden).
